start: Owner on Today; the gym has members, plans, receipts and check-ins

user_sees: Heading 'Your numbers'
Range chips '7 days', '30 days', '90 days', 'Pick dates'
'Last 30 days, and plans ending in the next 30. Tap a number to see who is behind it.'
Five tiles: 'Renewals due', 'Fees due', 'Stopped coming', 'New members', 'Busy hours'
must_not: 'Fees due' different from the total on Money, Dues
NaN or a blank in a tile

user_sees: A page titled 'Renewals due' with 'Next 30 days'
One row per member: plan name, 'ends' or 'ended', the day
must_not: A member who already renewed early listed as due
A pass member (FITPASS, cultpass) listed
An archived member listed
The same member twice

user_sees: Today, with the same range still picked
must_not: The range reset to another value

user_sees: A page titled 'Fees due' listing who owes, oldest debt first; archived members who still owe are included
must_not: A total that differs from the tile or from Money, Dues
A refunded or voided receipt still counted as paid

user_sees: The hours members check in; with no timed check-ins: 'No check-in times yet' and 'This fills in once members are checked in at the desk or scan the gym's code in the app.'
must_not: An empty chart with no words

start: Owner on Today, 'Your numbers', range '30 days'

user_sees: Tiles recount: 'Last 7 days' and renewals for 'Next 7 days'
must_not: A tile still showing the 30-day figure

steps.action: Tap 'Pick dates' and choose two dates
user_sees: Every tile shows the picked days, for example '1 Oct – 29 Oct 2026'
must_not: A range longer than 366 days accepted without a word
From and to swapped into a minus count

user_sees: The same range is still picked
must_not: The range forgotten

start: Owner of a brand-new gym with no members

user_sees: All five tiles with zero
must_not: An error, a spinner that never ends, NaN

user_sees: 'No plans end in these days' / 'Nobody needs to renew in these days.'
'Nobody owes money' / 'Every plan is fully paid.'
'Start checking members in' / 'After a few days of check-ins, this fills in by itself.'
'Nobody joined in these days' / 'Pick more days at the top to look further back.'
'No check-in times yet'
must_not: 'Everybody is coming' in a gym that has never checked anyone in

steps.action: Type a numbers address that does not exist (/numbers/abc)
user_sees: Not a numbers list (exact view unknown: not read)
must_not: A blank page or a crash

start: Owner; a member owes fees and their plan ends in 3 days

user_sees: The member is behind both numbers
must_not: The member missing from either list

steps.action: Collect the fee in full, then renew the plan from the day after it ends
user_sees: 'Fees due' drops by that amount; 'Renewals due' drops by one
must_not: Either number unchanged until a refresh of the browser

user_sees: 'Fees due' goes back up by the same amount
must_not: The voided money still counted as paid

steps.action: Archive a member who still owes
user_sees: They leave 'New members' and 'Renewals due' but stay in 'Fees due'
must_not: Archiving wiping what they owe

start: Owner and one staff person both signed in to the same gym

user_sees: The 'Fees due' tile and the link to the long view (growth)
must_not: Another gym's or branch's figures mixed in

steps.action: Owner downloads a list behind a number
user_sees: A file with that gym's members only
must_not: Members of another gym
Money columns in a file made by staff

start: Staff (front desk) on Today; the gym has members and check-ins

user_sees: Four tiles: 'Renewals due', 'Stopped coming', 'New members', 'Busy hours'
No 'Fees due' tile and no growth link
must_not: Any rupee total
A gap where the fifth tile would be

user_sees: A page titled 'Stopped coming' listing members with a running plan who stopped coming
must_not: Money owed shown on the rows

steps.action: Use the call or WhatsApp action on a row
user_sees: The phone's dialler or the WhatsApp sheet for that member
must_not: A message sent by itself

user_sees: Members who joined in the last 90 days, newest first, each with their plan words
must_not: Archived members listed
Price paid shown

start: Staff signed in; types the address of the owner's money list (/numbers/owed)

user_sees: The list does not open for staff; they are sent away from it (exact view unknown: not read)
must_not: The 'Fees due' list or any total shown to staff
The page title 'Fees due' flashing before the refusal

start: Staff; a member is in 'Stopped coming'

steps.action: Check that member in at the desk today
user_sees: 'Stopped coming' drops by one when Today is opened again
must_not: The member still listed after a check-in today

user_sees: The member is back in 'Stopped coming'
must_not: Busy hours still counting the undone check-in

user_sees: Names, plans and dates; the same members the desk already sees in Members
must_not: Fees, prices or money totals
Figures of another branch
